function.name: check_golden_ticket_availability_inbound
function.description: Checks open slots on DDP's Golden Ticket calendar ("Driven Doc AI 2026 — Golden Ticket Accelerator Call" with Gabe). Use ONLY for doctors who are not DDP members and want a Golden Ticket call about the Driven Doc AI event. For a regular Driven OS / coaching sales call, use check_gabriel_availability_inbound instead. Always call this before schedule_golden_ticket_inbound.

dateTime.description: The day (or day and time) the caller wants, in ISO 8601 with the caller's timezone offset, e.g. '2026-10-29T10:00:00-06:00'. Never use UTC (Z).

durationMinutes.description: Length of the call in minutes. Defaults to 30.

function.name: schedule_golden_ticket_inbound
function.description: Books a Golden Ticket call with Gabe on DDP's Golden Ticket calendar. Call only after check_golden_ticket_availability_inbound confirmed the slot and the caller agreed to it. Ask for the caller's email before calling this tool; it is required.

email.description: Doctor's email, collected on the call. Required.

contactId.description: GHL contact ID from ddp_check_contact or ddp_create_contact, if known.

startTime.description: The EXACT start time the caller chose, ISO 8601 with their timezone offset, e.g. '2026-10-29T10:00:00-06:00'. Never convert to UTC (Z).

endTime.description: startTime plus the call length, same timezone offset.

notes.description: Short notes for Gabe: practice name, monthly collections, main goal (save time with AI / lead the team / grow revenue).

function.name: reschedule_golden_ticket_inbound
function.description: Moves an existing Golden Ticket call to a new time. Check the new slot with check_golden_ticket_availability_inbound first.

phone.description: Caller's phone number, if contactId is unknown.

newStartTime.description: New start time, ISO 8601 with the caller's timezone offset. Never UTC (Z).

newEndTime.description: New end time, same timezone offset.
